observations.behavior: Adds a new prop `refreshCount` and a helper function `useReloadOnRefresh` that, when `refreshCount` changes, forces a reload of the heatmap query while checking if another load is already in progress. Also updates the import to include the type `dataNodeLogicType`.
observations.code_quote: /** Each change after the first render reloads the heatmap, unless a load is already running. */
observations.posthog_connection: Allows dashboard tiles or saved insights using the MetricsHistogramQuery to specify an auto-refresh behavior, potentially improving responsiveness for latency-over-time visualizations.

observations.behavior: Adds a `useEffect` that detects changes to `refreshCount` and calls `loadData('force_blocking')` unless the query is already loading, while also updating a stored reference to prevent repeated reloads.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements a guard against concurrent loads, suggesting a mechanism to avoid race conditions or redundant requests during auto-refresh, though the broader implementation and its effect on query performance are not demonstrated in this chunk.
